evidence.quote: the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 5 to 5-1/4 percent
In determining the extent to which additional policy firming may be appropriate to return inflation to 2 percent over time
Tighter credit conditions for households and businesses are likely to weigh on economic activity, hiring, and inflation.
